description: DB server scan: KISA infra(linux) + Oracle DBMS. Oracle connect string comes from SSM Parameter Store (SecureString), never echoed. Uploads both CSVs to S3 results/.

S3Base.description: S3 base prefix (tools/ and results/ live under it).

OracleConnParam.description: SSM Parameter Store name (SecureString) holding the Oracle connect string, e.g. oraadmin/PW@//localhost:1521/FREEPDB1 as sysdba

runCommand: if ! command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[!] aws CLI not available on this host'; exit 1; fi
aws s3 cp {{S3Base}}/tools/kisa_all_check.ps1 kisa_all_check.ps1 || { echo '[!] download kisa_all_check failed'; exit 1; }
timeout 600 bash kisa_all_check.ps1 --only infra -o scan; rc=$?; echo "[*] infra rc=$rc (124=timeout, else ignore)"
aws s3 cp {{S3Base}}/tools/db_oracle_check.sh db_oracle_check.sh || { echo '[!] download db_oracle_check failed'; exit 1; }
export ORACLE_CONN="$(aws ssm get-parameter --name {{OracleConnParam}} --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null)"

if [ -z "$ORACLE_CONN" ] || [ "$ORACLE_CONN" = 'None' ]; then echo '[!] Oracle conn param empty - create SecureString {{OracleConnParam}} first (skipping oracle scan)'; else ( cd scan && timeout 300 bash ../db_oracle_check.sh ); echo "[*] oracle rc=$? (124=timeout, else ignore)"; fi
ls scan/*.csv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[!] no CSV produced'; exit 1; }
aws s3 cp scan/ {{S3Base}}/results/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.csv' || { echo '[!] S3 upload failed - check this instance IAM role has s3:PutObject'; exit 1; }
